show.description: After five years away, army officer Samrat returns to propose to his longtime love, only to be brutally rejected for being “poor,” while his true identity as a billionaire CEO remains hidden. Heartbroken, he enters a contract marriage with ambitious businesswoman Priya, believing it to be nothing more than a deal. But everything changes when Samrat’s real power is dramatically revealed at a grand public event.
